create_cct_model: create a CCT vision transformer model with cct_14 for image classification on 224x224 images
build_tokenizer_conv: build a Tokenizer that converts 3-channel images into sequence tokens using conv layers and pooling
create_attention_module: create a multi-head Attention module with qkv projections, softmax, and dropout
build_transformer_classifier: build a TransformerClassifier with positional embeddings, transformer blocks, and attention pooling
run_cct_forward: run a CCT model forward pass to classify images into num_classes categories
